about: File paths linked in a bot's reply (#251), by the web page (public/app.js filePaths) and the Android app (filePaths in FilePaths.kt). paths: each path linked in the plain text, as written. A path counts when it is under /home/box or /workspace, starts with ~/, or is relative to the bot's workspace, has a file extension the apps know, has no .. in it and is no web address; a bare name that is one capitalised word (Node.js) stays text. code: whether a `code` span that is exactly that text is linked too; a fenced code block never is.
